@@@ case 32 (planted in a copy of a file of the tree)
/** Specification of the story demonstrated by the page. */
const STORY = "docs/backlog/stories/E01-F02-US-007-shape-selector-playground.md";

/**
 * Selects a required element of the page by its id.
 *
 * @kind procedure
 * @param document - page document
 * @param id - `id` attribute, without `#`
 * @returns the HTML element carrying this `id`
 * @see docs/backlog/stories/E01-F01-US-002-sharp-rectangle-in-playground.md
 */
export function selectElement(document: Document, id: string): HTMLElement {
  const element = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`#${id}`);

  if (element === null) {
    throw new Error(`Playground page without #${id} (${STORY}).`);
  }

  return element;
}

@@@ case 33 (written for a branch the documented cases leave)
/**
 * Throws in places.
 */
function places(a: boolean, list: number[]) {
  while (a) { throw new Error("1"); }
  do { throw new Error("2"); } while (a);
  for (const each of list) { throw new Error("3"); }
  for (const each in list) { throw new Error("4"); }
  label: { throw new Error("5"); }
  with (a) { throw new Error("6"); }
}
/**
 * Switch.
 */
function switched(a: number) {
  switch (a) { case 1: throw new Error("x"); }
}
/**
 * Finally.
 */
function finale() {
  try { a(); } finally { throw new Error("x"); }
}
/**
 * Inner function only.
 */
function outer() {
  function inner() { throw new Error("x"); }
}
/**
 * Never.
 *
 * @throws {never} nothing
 */
function never() { throw new Error("x"); }
/**
 * Arrow expression.
 */
const arrow = () => 1;
